whatThisPluginAdds.text: API adds versioned public JSON endpoints for resolving published Capell pages and bounded Layout Builder graphs.

surfaceOutcome.text: The package adds no admin screen. Headless clients can resolve a published page and request its sanitized public layout payload through the documented API routes.

developers.text: ResolveApiRequestContextAction, BuildPublicPagePayloadAction, and BuildPublicLayoutPayloadAction keep request resolution, sanitization, and layout bounds outside the controller.

teams.text: A separate frontend can consume published Capell content without receiving draft, admin, or authoring state.
